publicEvidenceClass: sanitized transcription of a dedicated-account live run
rawDirectoryMeaning: Earliest public-safe observations, not byte-for-byte Azure logs. Scenario files carry only fields the measured probe or the ACI launcher emitted plus run and sequence metadata; post-run derived values live under control-plane.json derivedFingerprints
privateSourceRetention: Exact commands, probe outputs, management reads, and identifiers are retained outside this public repository
publicVerificationBoundary: Repository hashes and evaluators prove internal consistency and change detection; they do not independently authenticate the withheld source
hashCanonicalization: SHA-256 uses UTF-8 text normalized to LF; binary assets use raw bytes
observationTimeBasis: observedAtUtc comes from the probe output or post-test management read, not a service-side request timestamp
liveRunSequence: authenticated public request returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while public network access was Enabled
private-IP ACI returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while public network access was Enabled
authenticated public request blocked while public network access was Disabled
the same private-IP ACI code path returned a Chat Completions HTTP 200 while public network access was Disabled
authenticated public request returned HTTP 200 after public network access was restored
privateRunner: Private-IP Azure Container Instances in a linked VNet workload subnet; not Azure Bastion
privateEndpointPathInference: The only retained public evidence that the ACI path used the Private Endpoint is dnsClass=private (RFC 1918 resolved address inside the linked VNet). The resolved address was not compared with the Private Endpoint NIC address in the public evidence
sourceContinuity: The five argv command receipts share one endpoint and one deployment, and one Azure CLI profile supplied the Entra subject. The five SHA-256 fingerprints were derived from those receipts at 2026-08-31T06:45:33Z, after the last probe; the measured probe emitted only hostnameSha256 and requestIdSha256. endpoint, deployment, and request digests are recomputable from the real argv values; identity requires the tenant and object IDs
measuredScriptBoundary: The 2026-08-31 run executed the 762b6978 versions of all scripts. That set_public_network_access.py saved and restored the prior state without ETag capture or If-Match preconditions, and that submit_private_aci_probe.py passed a launcher-computed source digest into the container. ETag preconditions and in-container hashing exist in the current scripts with unit tests but have no live measurement in this repository
postRunHardening: The current probe adds native fingerprints, the ACI launcher is create-only and hashes the executed bytes inside the container, and the public network access restore path uses ETag preconditions. connectivity-run.json separately hashes the current executable files.
fieldRetentionBoundary: Successful probes retain DNS class, HTTP status, response object, model, choice count, usage, and request-ID digest; completion text and resolved IP addresses are omitted
postTestBoundary: Public network access was restored and both ACI probes terminated with exit code 0. Dedicated resources remain, cleanup is awaiting explicit user authorization, and Managed Compute billing continues.
